user.title: Carrier AC
user.description: Select the IR emitter that transmits to the air conditioner. On an ESPHome IR blaster this is the entity created by the ir_rf_proxy transmitter platform.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Shown as the current temperature. The AC is controlled open-loop either way.

abort.already_configured: This IR emitter is already configured.
